title: Convincement
description: A specialized chat-interaction plugin for Purpur 1.21.1+, featuring custom automated responses for specific player triggers. Built and compiled entirely on mobile.
body:
[ Convincement ]
A tiny, targeted plugin that changes the chat dynamic for just one player: The Rock.
How to use:
When "The Rock" joins the server and types "Quit loving me" in global chat, they will get a unique, automated, pink reply.
Developer's Note:
This plugin was manually coded, compiled via Termux, and deployed on a Purpur 1.21.1 server running on a Samsung A07 using the standard Java 25 (OpenJDK). The development process required manually managing dependencies for Kyori Adventure and Bungee-Chat to navigate the slim Purpur JAR structure.
